description: A beached craft (issue #72): driven up the sand of the free ride's big island, it stops out of the water with its intake dry, where the throttle can't move it; holding reverse, the rider shoves it back down to the water, where it floats and reverses away. The hull's friction is raised to 0.5 here, so it stays on this 15-degree beach (at 0.25 it slides back into the water by itself).

steps.name: heading for the island's beach at 22 km/h
beached: up the sand, no hull point in the water
the throttle can't move it: the intake is dry
holding reverse, the rider pushes it back into the water
afloat and backing away under reverse thrust
